CREATE SCHEMA dw;
GO

CREATE TABLE dw.DIM_DEPARTMENT (
    DepartmentID   INT          NOT NULL,
    DepartmentName VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE, CLUSTERED INDEX (DepartmentID));
ALTER TABLE dw.DIM_DEPARTMENT ADD CONSTRAINT PK_DIM_DEPARTMENT
    PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (DepartmentID) NOT ENFORCED;

CREATE TABLE dw.DIM_EMPLOYEE (
    EmployeeID     INT          NOT NULL,
    DepartmentID   INT          NOT NULL,
    Campus         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    Position       VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    SeniorityYears TINYINT      NOT NULL,
    IsContractor   TINYINT      NOT NULL
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE, CLUSTERED INDEX (EmployeeID));
ALTER TABLE dw.DIM_EMPLOYEE ADD CONSTRAINT PK_DIM_EMPLOYEE
    PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (EmployeeID) NOT ENFORCED;

CREATE TABLE dw.DIM_DATE (
    DateKey    INT          NOT NULL,
    FullDate   DATE         NOT NULL,
    [Year]     SMALLINT     NOT NULL,
    [Quarter]  TINYINT      NOT NULL,
    [Month]    TINYINT      NOT NULL,
    MonthName  VARCHAR(15)  NOT NULL,
    [Day]      TINYINT      NOT NULL,
    DayOfWeek  TINYINT      NOT NULL,
    DayName    VARCHAR(15)  NOT NULL,
    IsWeekend  TINYINT      NOT NULL
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE, CLUSTERED INDEX (DateKey));
ALTER TABLE dw.DIM_DATE ADD CONSTRAINT PK_DIM_DATE
    PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (DateKey) NOT ENFORCED;

CREATE TABLE dw.FACT_DAILY_ACTIVITY (
    ActivityID              INT           NOT NULL,
    EmployeeID              INT           NOT NULL,
    DateKey                 INT           NOT NULL,
    ActivityDate            DATE          NOT NULL,
    FirstEntryTime          VARCHAR(10)   NULL,
    LastExitTime            VARCHAR(10)   NULL,
    TotalPresenceMinutes    SMALLINT      NOT NULL,
    PresenceHours           DECIMAL(5,2)  NOT NULL,
    EarlyEntryFlag          TINYINT       NOT NULL,
    LateExitFlag            TINYINT       NOT NULL,
    EnteredDuringNightHours TINYINT       NOT NULL,
    EntryDuringWeekend      TINYINT       NOT NULL,
    NumEntries              SMALLINT      NOT NULL,
    NumExits                SMALLINT      NOT NULL,
    NumPrintCommands        SMALLINT      NOT NULL,
    TotalPrintedPages       SMALLINT      NOT NULL,
    NumUniqueCampus         TINYINT       NOT NULL,
    IsAbroad                TINYINT       NOT NULL,
    TripDayNumber           SMALLINT      NOT NULL
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = HASH(EmployeeID), CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX);
ALTER TABLE dw.FACT_DAILY_ACTIVITY ADD CONSTRAINT PK_FACT_DAILY_ACTIVITY
    PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (ActivityID) NOT ENFORCED;
GO



COPY INTO dw.DIM_DEPARTMENT
FROM 'https://depitest1111.blob.core.windows.net/depitest1111systemfile/personal%20digital%20twin/DIM_DEPARTMENT.csv'
WITH (FILE_TYPE='CSV', FIRSTROW=2, CREDENTIAL=(IDENTITY='Managed Identity'));

COPY INTO dw.DIM_EMPLOYEE
FROM 'https://depitest1111.blob.core.windows.net/depitest1111systemfile/personal digital twin/DIM_EMPLOYEE.csv'
WITH (FILE_TYPE='CSV', FIRSTROW=2, CREDENTIAL=(IDENTITY='Managed Identity'));

COPY INTO dw.DIM_DATE
FROM 'https://depitest1111.blob.core.windows.net/depitest1111systemfile/personal digital twin/DIM_DATE.csv'
WITH (FILE_TYPE='CSV', FIRSTROW=2, CREDENTIAL=(IDENTITY='Managed Identity'));

COPY INTO dw.FACT_DAILY_ACTIVITY
FROM 'https://depitest1111.blob.core.windows.net/depitest1111systemfile/personal digital twin/FACT_DAILY_ACTIVITY.csv'
WITH (FILE_TYPE='CSV', FIRSTROW=2, CREDENTIAL=(IDENTITY='Managed Identity'));
